editorial:
Imagine heading back to your college reunion only to find out your ex wrote a bestselling book about your private life. That is exactly what happens to Alice in this movie. Set at the beautiful Hunter College in Atlanta, you get to follow the messy reunion of Alice and Miles. Miles is a successful author who still holds a grudge, while Alice is trying to pick up the pieces of her life after a public divorce from an NFL star. The vibe is a perfect mix of sexy tension and heartfelt drama, making you feel like you are right there on campus with them as they argue and flirt their way back into each other's lives.

What really makes this story work is the chemistry between the leads and the shocking twists regarding a secret child. The acting feels real, and the pacing keeps you interested without feeling too slow. While some of the family drama with the judge feels a bit over the top, the emotional payoffs are worth it. You should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the gorgeous Atlanta scenery, or maybe grab the 4K Blu-ray if you love collecting high-quality physical copies. It is a great pick for a date night or a solo binge.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Alice finally tells Miles that he has a child. After a huge emotional blowout, Miles realizes his book was just a way to cope with his pain. He apologizes for exposing their past and decides to be a present father. Alice finally stands up to her father, the judge, and chooses her own happiness. The movie ends with Miles and Alice reuniting as a couple, ready to raise their child together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves second-chance romances and juicy family secrets.
